sonnet.problem: The opening story card names Moses and Aaron, which is the right answer to the choice on card 2 (the people who found the man bring him to Moses, Aaron and the whole congregation). That gives away the answer and lets a baker rule out the wrong answers (Joshua and Caleb, Eleazar).
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: Verse 40 says "Then you will remember and obey all My commandments, and you will be holy to your God." The statement recasts this as "when the Israelites remember and obey all His commandments, they will be holy." That makes obeying the cause of holiness, a connection the text doesn't state.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
